description: Curated Fluent TUI catalog. Coverage is intentionally partial: only commands whose menu path and availability across the supported version window are well established are listed. Unknown commands never produce errors - only low-confidence heuristic notes. introduced/removed use version ids from fluent_versions.json (null = available across the whole shipped window).

/file/set-tui-version.summary: Declare which Fluent TUI version the journal targets so later releases keep replaying it.

/exit.summary: Exit Fluent; with a yes argument it discards unsaved data without prompting.

/file/read-data.summary: Read a data file for the current case.

/file/read-case-data.summary: Read a case and its data file.

/file/write-case-data.summary: Write both case and data files.

/file/read-mesh.summary: Read a mesh file without case settings.

/file/write-mesh.summary: Write the mesh to a file.

/file/export-ensight-gold.summary: Export solution data in EnSight Gold format.

/file/auto-save/root-name.summary: Set the root file name used by automatic case/data saving.

/file/auto-save/data-frequency.summary: Set how often data files are auto-saved.

/file/auto-save/case-frequency.summary: Set how often case files are auto-saved.

/file/auto-save/retain-most-recent-files.summary: Control retention of older autosave files.

/file/start-transcript.summary: Start writing a transcript of the session to a file.

/file/start-journal.summary: Start recording subsequent actions into a journal file.

/file/confirm-overwrite.summary: Enable or disable overwrite confirmation prompts for file output.

/solve/initialize/initialize-flow.summary: Initialize the flow field with the current default values.

/solve/monitor/set-command.summary: Define a command executed by the solution monitor.

/define/models/viscous/ke-standard.summary: Select the standard k-epsilon turbulence model.

/define/models/viscous/kw-sst.summary: Select the k-omega SST turbulence model.

/define/models/energy.summary: Enable or disable the energy equation.

/define/boundary-conditions/velocity-inl.summary: Set conditions for a velocity-inlet zone.

/define/boundary-conditions/pressure-inl.summary: Set conditions for a pressure-inlet zone.

/define/boundary-conditions/mass-flow-in.summary: Set conditions for a mass-flow-inlet zone.

/define/boundary-conditions/pressure-out.summary: Set conditions for a pressure-outlet zone.

/define/boundary-conditions/outflow.summary: Set conditions for an outflow zone.

/define/boundary-conditions/wall.summary: Set conditions for a wall zone.

/define/boundary-conditions/symmetry.summary: Set conditions for a symmetry zone.

/define/boundary-conditions/axis.summary: Set conditions for an axis boundary.

/define/boundary-conditions/interior.summary: Set conditions for an interior zone.

/define/boundary-conditions/periodic.summary: Set conditions for a periodic zone.

/report/surface-integrals.summary: Report surface integrals such as area or flux.

/report/forces.summary: Report forces and moments on zones.

/report/fluxes/mass-flow.summary: Report mass flow rate through boundaries.

/report/summary.summary: Write a summary report of the setup.

/solve/set/pseudo-time-scale-factor.summary: Set the pseudo-time step scale factor.

/solve/report-files/add.summary: Add a report file that writes report definitions during the run.

/solve/report-definitions/add.summary: Add a report definition (surface/volume integrals, expressions).

/define/parameters/enable-in-tui.summary: Enable parameter handling inside the TUI.

/define/operating-conditions/gravity.summary: Enable gravity and set gravitational acceleration.

/define/models/viscous/near-wall-treatme.summary: Select wall omega near-wall treatment for k-omega models.

/mesh/prepare-for-solve.summary: Prepare the mesh for the solver (quality checks/fixes).

/switch-to-solution-mode.summary: Switch the Fluent session from meshing mode to solution mode.

/switch-to-meshing-mode.summary: Switch the Fluent session into meshing mode.

gui_prefixes./display/: Graphics display commands require the graphics pipeline.
gui_prefixes./plot/: Plotting requires the graphics pipeline or plot file handling.
gui_prefixes./views/: View manipulation belongs to the GUI layer.
gui_prefixes./scene/: Scene manipulation belongs to the GUI layer.
gui_prefixes./graphics/: Graphics rendering options belong to the GUI layer.

prompt_prone./exit: A bare /exit asks whether unsaved data should be saved; journals normally end with '/exit yes' when run in batch.
